risk_summary: The excerpt indicates severe operating weakness, including de minimis sales, recurring net losses, negative working capital, limited cash, and continued reliance on external financing. Liquidity depends on access to a $5 million revolving facility at 12% interest, while manufacturing, patent commercialization, supply-chain, and legal risks remain material. Extensive boilerplate disclaimers and emphasis on non-GAAP measures somewhat dilute the presentation of these risks.
